editorial.intro: Pointed fighter noses, broad swept wings and paired exhausts dominate these Sukhoi illustrations. Superjet airliners and single propeller aircraft add contrasting forms, while experimental subjects retain their development context instead of appearing as ordinary current products.
paragraphs: Pointed fighter noses, broad swept wings and paired exhausts dominate these Sukhoi illustrations. Superjet airliners and single propeller aircraft add contrasting forms, while experimental subjects retain their development context instead of appearing as ordinary current products.

This collection includes {{artworkCount}} artworks in color and black and white. Overhead views, underside banks and isolated profiles show differences in canards, cockpit length and engine placement. Closely related fighter designs keep broad family names where exact variants cannot be established from the artwork.

editorial.intro: Glazed noses, swept wings and distinctive engine arrangements shape these Tupolev illustrations. Rear engine airliners, delta wing aircraft and large propeller subjects offer different outlines, alongside historical aircraft and clearly qualified experimental designs.
